court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sarang Diwakar Amle And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sarang Diwakar Amle, Saroj Diwakar Amle, Dipti Ashutosh Athalye (husband, mother, sister-in-law)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra, Shruti Sarang Amle alias Shruti Shantaram Palnitkar (state, wife)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage expenses were borne by respondent No.2's father; applicants treated her poorly after a month; FIR lodged for offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person making allegations to prove them.
legal_principles.held: After dissolution of marriage on 11.04.2019, present applicant No.1 has performed marriage with respondent No.2 on 12.12.2019. Her stay with the applicants was very much short.
cited_cases: Sarang Diwakar Amle And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another, (2022)

legal_principles.principle: A person's past behavior can be considered in determining the credibility of their allegations.
legal_principles.held: Respondent No.2 is in habit of making such allegations.
cited_cases: Sarang Diwakar Amle And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another, (2022)

outcome.final_order: FIR bearing Crime No.341 of 2020 registered with Bhagyanagar Police Station, Dist. Nanded is quashed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
